# Public post

The smallest campaign in the vault, and the one that demonstrates the public
boundary: it reads with no session, its pages are in the search index, and its
assets are fetched without an authorisation check.

- [[town-notice]]

Everything in this campaign is reachable from this page, which is the same rule
[[/greyhaven/index|the showcase campaign]] holds itself to.
